grid_rebalance.mechanism: bounded-range inventory pressure can mean-revert after a sufficiently large anchor excursion and reclaim, but static grid expectation is fragile without regime control
grid_rebalance.payer_constraint: late range-extreme participants and short-horizon inventory imbalance when price re-enters a stable local range
grid_rebalance.observable_entry_event: closed bar beyond 1.10 normalized grid steps from a prior 96-bar anchor, reclaiming versus prior close, with ATR bounds and opposing-trend veto
grid_rebalance.regime: bounded volatility/range; no-trade in strong opposing EMA trend or chase extension
grid_rebalance.invalidation: 1.25 grid-step structural stop; no adverse averaging
grid_rebalance.exit: 1.50R target and 36-bar time-stop; no partial/trailing/runner/pyramiding in v2
grid_rebalance.turnover_cost: single transition entry, duplicate forbidden, verified round-trip cost required, gross move/cost budget >=1.25
grid_rebalance.falsification: planted reclaim edge must pass; direction flip/time placebo/delayed entry must remain distinct; missing cost/stale/duplicate input must fail closed

rbreaker_like.mechanism: prior range boundaries create reference points; decisive breach can continue while failed breach/reclaim can reverse
rbreaker_like.payer_constraint: stops and inventory re-pricing clustered around prior range extremes
rbreaker_like.observable_entry_event: closed-bar breach of prior 48-bar high/low with ATR buffer and EMA confirmation, or failed breach followed by reclaim
rbreaker_like.regime: directional expansion or failed-break reversal; no-trade on excessive chase or ATR outlier
rbreaker_like.exit: 2.00R target and 36-bar time-stop; no scale-in/retest add
rbreaker_like.turnover_cost: one entry per transition, verified round-trip cost mandatory, gross move/cost >=1.25
failure_modes: range boundary contaminated by current bar
rbreaker_like.falsification: excluding current bar from range must be invariant; planted breach/reclaim edge passes while negative controls remain separable

session_bias.mechanism: crypto liquidity, volatility and price discovery vary systematically by global trading session, changing breakout continuation odds
session_bias.payer_constraint: session handoff liquidity and inventory adjustment as major market participation opens/overlaps
session_bias.observable_entry_event: UTC session label plus prior 24-bar range break/reclaim with EMA direction and bounded ATR
session_bias.regime: asia/london/newyork/overlap explicit; no-trade for unknown timestamp or excessive chase
session_bias.side_policy: symmetric long/short; session is regime, not directional prior
session_bias.turnover_cost: single transition entry, verified cost required, gross move/cost >=1.25
failure_modes: session label mistaken for directional alpha
session_bias.falsification: session timestamp permutation/time placebo must destroy session-specific identity without changing accounting; stale/unknown time fails closed

sr_levels.mechanism: prior swing highs/lows act as reference barriers; breakouts with participation expansion can trigger repricing and role reversal
sr_levels.payer_constraint: clustered stops, breakout orders and passive liquidity around prior swing levels
sr_levels.observable_entry_event: closed bar beyond prior 50-bar swing high/low by 0.12 ATR with relative volume >=1.80 and EMA slope confirmation
sr_levels.regime: volume-confirmed expansion; no-trade with missing volume, ATR outlier or chase extension
sr_levels.turnover_cost: one transition entry, verified cost required, gross move/cost >=1.25
sr_levels.falsification: prior-window-only level invariant plus planted volume breakout PASS; missing volume/stale/duplicate/cost authority fail closed
